race.comment: AURORA'S BELT (4) brings the most interesting profile despite being unplaced in five starts, with a solid fourth two runs back at Pakenham Synthetic before a sixth over 1400m there when close enough but unable to finish off. The move to the Matthew McGuire stable and the class drop give her a clear chance, though the back in trip is the test. STYLISH ROSIE (8) looks the safest recent-form rival after a Townsville second and has placed twice from three starts at 1200m, with an easy Townsville trial adding useful polish. MOONYA LAD (2) has placed at all three runs this season and was favourite when third at Cairns, so he is close, but he still has to convert. FOXTROTTING (1) was much better fresh at Townsville at long odds and draws to get every opportunity if the rise to 1200m suits.
